content.text:
This is a clean, generic landing-page template (SEO meta, dark/light theme toggle, scroll-spy nav). A few real ambiguities before I improve it:

1. Is this meant to stay a generic starter template (so I should focus on code quality/bugs), or should I fill in actual content (title, description, site URL, contact email) for a real project?
2. Any specific issues you've noticed (bugs, accessibility, performance), or should I do a general pass?

If you just want a general code-quality pass, my plan would be: fix the `og:url`/canonical/ld+json all pointing to placeholder `example.com` (fine to leave as a template but worth flagging), add a `noscript` fallback for the theme toggle, and guard the IntersectionObserver/theme code against missing elements. Let me know which direction you want.
